lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is the Parks & Recreation Commission meeting Wednesday, July 29 at noon, where commissioners take up the already-approved plan to pave the Town Park grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts — a project that has drawn more than 400 signatures and letters in opposition. The rest of the week is quieter on the decision-making front, with the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo, New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet, and a free Jungle Book production at the Sheridan rounding out a full valley weekend.

notable.stake: Commission revisits controversial Town Park paving opposed by 400+ residents.
